preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2*10**5 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Length of each string is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= 10**9 for k in ks)
preconditions.description: Maximum number of operations is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(s.islower() and s.isalpha() for s in ss)
preconditions.description: Each string consists of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(len(result) == ns[i] for i, result in enumerate(output))
postconditions.description: Each output string has the same length as the corresponding input string.

postconditions.expression: all(result.islower() and result.isalpha() for result in output)
postconditions.description: Each output string consists of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: all(result <= original for original, result in zip(ss, output))
postconditions.description: Each output string is lexicographically less than or equal to the corresponding input string.

postconditions.expression: all(sum((ord(original[i]) - ord(result[i])) for i in range(len(original))) <= ks[i] for i, (original, result) in enumerate(zip(ss, output)))
postconditions.description: The total number of operations used in each output string does not exceed the corresponding maximum number of operations.
